items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: That was a good band. Had Willy Roland on the piano, Terry Schneider on the drums.

ctx.x: bands, I remember one band that you were in, I mean, every musician in there to me was like the epitome of a musician, that was the Perry Como band. I remember Bob Haggart was the bass player. Name some of the guys in that band.

That was a good band. Had Willy Roland on the piano, Terry Schneider on the drums. Terry Schneider was probably the busiest drummer in New York, and probably the most worried drummer in New York. An insecure fellow, he died of colitis, a massive heart attack, and everything just fell apart all at once, literally.
He was working around the clock.
